status: COMPLETE: all sections written (1 codes, 2 T parts, 3 a-f base)
units: mm, assembly space (mra.glb x 1000), Y up

T_parts.guess: free-standing block for the claw to pick up; not part of base/controller/arm/claw

alternative.what: horn turned along Z drops straight through the slot when the turret is at least 8.7 mm towards -Z of its seat

servo_into_R1.pose_convention: turn r=[ax, ay, az, degrees] about the axis through `at`, then move by t; relative to the seated position (same as stepgen.turned)

B_as_in_video.note: servo and horn move as one rigid piece; this is the sequence the video report (video_base_seg1.md, 0:18-0:22) describes

poses.name: B0
poses.what: above R1, quarter-turn about the shaft away from seated, laid over 60 deg

poses.name: B1
poses.what: straight down: leading horn tip through the hole, 10 mm below R1

poses.name: B2
poses.what: swung upright: hub and trailing tip through (trailing tip through the notch)

poses.name: B3
poses.what: slid 6 mm towards +Z: shaft on its seated axis

poses.name: B4
poses.what: twisted back a quarter-turn about the shaft axis (only possible at lift 7.40-7.75)

poses.name: B5
poses.what: pressed down: seated, ears on R1

B_as_in_video.decomposition: turn = Rx(pitch) * Ry(+90 deg), pitch -60 deg for B0-B1 and 0 for B2-B3; between B1 and B2 the pitch and t are interpolated linearly
